value.name: Lucia explains withholding the letter
value.description: Lucia admits she hid the letter because she feared what it would do to him and hoped the codicil would handle the matter instead.
evidence: "Because I knew what was in it. I knew what it would do to him. I thought — I thought if I could find the codicil first, I wouldn't have to be the one to do it to him. I thought the codicil would do it and the letter would just be — context. I didn't want to be the person who took the house away from him."

value.name: Rosa blames mother for taking the house
value.description: Rosa tells Lucia that she did not take the house away, because their mother did.
evidence: "You didn't take it away from him. Your mother did."

value.name: Asha confronts Lucia about delay
value.description: Asha reveals that Lucia knew about the letter six days earlier and warns her that withholding it could have undermined the estate's legal position.
evidence: "Ms. Serrano. I am not your priest. I am not going to tell you whether what you did was right or wrong. I am going to tell you that withholding that letter for six days could have cost your mother's wishes their legal force, and that if your brother had succeeded in selling this house before we had the codicil in hand, the letter would have been worth, in court, perhaps a third of what it is worth now. Do you understand me."

value.name: Asha warns Lucia not to repeat delay
value.description: Asha orders Lucia not to withhold anything like that again in this estate matter.
evidence: "Do not do anything like that again. Not with me. Not in this estate."

value.name: Rosa reassures Lucia about the letter
value.description: Rosa quietly tells Lucia that their mother wanted her to find the letter and that waiting was the real betrayal, not finding it.
evidence: "She wanted you to find it. She said in the letter. She knew it would be you. That is not — that is not nothing. You did not betray anyone by finding it. You only betrayed someone by waiting."

value.name: Lucia silently accepts reassurance
value.description: Lucia does not respond verbally but nods once, and Asha lets the matter rest.
evidence: "Lucia did not answer. She nodded, once. Asha did not push it."

value.name: Daniel returns with green folder
value.description: The front door opens and Daniel comes back into the dining room carrying the green folder that matches Rosa's description.
evidence: "The front door opened. Footsteps in the hall, two sets. Daniel came back into the dining room with a green folder in his hands. It was a manila folder dyed green, with a pocket on the inside, exactly as Rosa had described."
